name: repository URL view
prompt: Call gh_view exactly once with target https://github.com/cli/cli, then stop. Do not call gh_find or any other tool.

name: focused issue search
prompt: Call gh_find for issue search, then call gh_search_issues exactly once for cli/cli and authentication. Stop after that result.

name: uncommon REST read
prompt: Call gh_find for an uncommon REST API read, then call gh_api_get exactly once for repos/cli/cli/issues with state=open. Stop after that result; do not mutate anything.

name: guarded close
prompt: Call gh_find for issue closure, then call gh_close_issue exactly once for cli/cli#1. It may fail closed because this run has no confirmation UI; do not substitute gh_view.
